title: COLOURS AND SHAPES
goal: Students can identify and name basic colours and shapes in English.
goal_vi: Học sinh có thể nhận biết và gọi tên các màu sắc và hình dạng cơ bản bằng tiếng Anh.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant outdoor park scene with diverse children playing. One child is holding a red ball, another is flying a kite shaped like a blue diamond. A yellow sun shines in the sky. There are green trees and a brown slide in the shape of a rectangle. A round clock on a building shows the time. The scene is full of bright colours and clear shapes.

big_question.en: What colours and shapes do you see around you?
big_question.vi: Em thấy những màu sắc và hình dạng nào xung quanh mình?
prompts: What colour is your pencil case?
Is your book a square or a rectangle?
What colour is the sky today?
Do you like circles or stars?

examples: What colour is it? It is red.

patterns.vi: Tôi nhìn thấy một hình (hình dạng) màu (màu sắc).

grammar.title: This is / It is
grammar.explain_en: We use 'This is' to point to one thing. We use 'It is' to talk about one thing.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'This is' để chỉ một vật. Chúng ta dùng 'It is' để nói về một vật.

grammar.title: What colour is it?
grammar.explain_en: We use 'What colour is it?' to ask about the colour of one thing.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'What colour is it?' để hỏi về màu sắc của một vật.
examples: What colour is it? It is green.
What colour is your bag? It is blue.
What colour is the flower? It is pink.

grammar.title: What shape is it?
grammar.explain_en: We use 'What shape is it?' to ask about the shape of one thing.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'What shape is it?' để hỏi về hình dạng của một vật.
examples: What shape is it? It is a triangle.
What shape is the window? It is a rectangle.
What shape is the clock? It is a circle.

grammar.title: The + Noun + is + Adjective
grammar.explain_en: We use this to describe the colour or shape of a noun.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng cấu trúc này để mô tả màu sắc hoặc hình dạng của một danh từ.

song.title: Colours and Shapes Everywhere
song.tune: Sing to the tune of 'Twinkle Twinkle Little Star'
lines: Red and blue, and yellow too,
Green and orange, I see you!
Purple, pink, and brown, and white,
Shapes are fun for me and you!
Rectangle, star, and heart so sweet,
Shapes and colours, can't be beat!
Red and blue, and yellow too,
I see colours, I see shapes with you!
song.actions_vi: Khi hát 'Red', chạm vào áo màu đỏ. Khi hát 'Blue', chỉ lên trời. Khi hát 'Yellow', chỉ vào mặt trời. Khi hát 'Circle', vẽ một hình tròn trong không khí. Khi hát 'Square', dùng tay tạo hình vuông. Khi hát 'Triangle', dùng ngón tay tạo hình tam giác. Khi hát 'Colours shining', vẫy tay lên cao. Khi hát 'Shapes are fun', giơ ngón cái lên.

readings.title: MY COLOURFUL WORLD
readings.text: My name is Linh. I am seven years old. I love colours! I see red. The apple is red. I see blue. The sky is blue. I see yellow. The sun is yellow. I see green. The grass is green. Colours are everywhere! I love shapes too. The ball is a circle. The book is a rectangle. The window is a square. The roof is a triangle. The stars are stars! My world is colourful and full of shapes.
readings.image_prompt: A happy Vietnamese girl, Linh, pointing at different colourful objects around her in a simple, bright outdoor setting. She points at a red apple, then to the blue sky, then a yellow sun, and green grass. Simple shapes like a square window and a triangular roof are visible in the background.

true_false.statement: Linh's world is full of shapes.

readings.title: A WALK IN THE PARK
readings.text: Ben and Mia are at the park. They see many colours and shapes. Ben sees a big red ball. It is a circle. Mia sees a yellow kite. The kite is a diamond shape. Look! A green tree. Its leaves are green. The bench is brown. It is a long rectangle. Ben sees a pink flower. It is beautiful. Mia sees a white cloud. It is an oval shape. A small blue bird flies by. The bird is so cute. They love to see colours and shapes in the park.
readings.image_prompt: Ben, an English boy, and Mia, a Vietnamese girl, are walking happily in a sunny park. Ben points at a big red ball. Mia points at a yellow diamond-shaped kite in the sky. A green tree, a brown rectangular bench, a pink flower, and a white oval cloud are visible. A small blue bird flies in the distance.
questions: What colour is the ball Ben sees?
What shape is the red ball?
What colour are the tree leaves?
What colour is the flower Ben sees?
What shape is the white cloud?

true_false.statement: Ben and Mia are at school.

readings.title: MY FAVOURITE ROOM
readings.text: This is my room. It is my favourite room. I have many colourful things and fun shapes here. My bed is a big rectangle. My blanket is blue. My pillow is white and soft. On my wall, I have a big red star. It is very pretty. There is a small brown table. It is a square. On the table, there is a yellow lamp. The lamp shade is a circle. I have a box for my toys. The box is orange and it is a rectangle. My rug is green and has many small pink hearts. I like to draw. My drawing paper is white. I draw big colourful circles and small funny triangles. My room is a happy place!

A small brown square table holds a yellow lamp with a circular shade. An orange rectangular toy box is on the floor. A green rug with many small pink hearts covers part of the floor. A Vietnamese child, perhaps Minh, is sitting at the table drawing colourful circles and triangles on white paper. The room looks cheerful.

conversations.title: What Colour is This?
conversations.image_prompt: Two children, Minh (Vietnamese boy) and Lucy (English girl), are sitting at a table with a box of crayons and a picture book. Minh holds up a red crayon, and Lucy points at a yellow sun in the book.

lines.speaker: Minh
lines.text: Lucy, look! What colour is this?

lines.speaker: Lucy
lines.text: That is yellow. Like the sun!

lines.speaker: Minh
lines.text: You are right! The sun is yellow.

lines.speaker: Lucy
lines.text: And the flower is pink. I like pink flowers.

lines.speaker: Minh
lines.text: Me too! Pink is a nice colour.

lines.speaker: Lucy
lines.text: What colour is your shirt, Minh?

conversations.title: What Shape is That?
conversations.image_prompt: Two children, An (Vietnamese girl) and Tom (English boy), are in a classroom. An points at a clock on the wall. Tom points at a book on his desk.

lines.speaker: An
lines.text: Tom, what shape is the clock?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The clock is a circle, An.

lines.speaker: An
lines.text: Oh, yes! A big circle. And what shape is your book?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: My book? It is a rectangle.

lines.speaker: An
lines.text: I see. My notebook is a rectangle too.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Look at the window. What shape is it?

lines.speaker: An
lines.text: The window is a big square!

White là màu sắc, các từ còn lại là hình dạng.

life_skill.title: SEE THE BEAUTY IN COLOURS AND SHAPES
life_skill.intro: Colours and shapes make our world beautiful! Look around you. Everything has a colour and a shape. Learning about them helps you understand and appreciate the world more.
life_skill.intro_vi: Màu sắc và hình dạng làm cho thế giới của chúng ta tươi đẹp! Hãy nhìn xung quanh em. Mọi thứ đều có màu sắc và hình dạng. Học về chúng giúp em hiểu và trân trọng thế giới hơn.

life_skill.value_question: What is your favourite colour and why do you like it?
life_skill.image_prompt: A group of diverse children, both Vietnamese and international, happily drawing and painting together on a large sheet of paper on the floor. They use many different colours and simple shapes in their artwork. The children are smiling and collaborating, surrounded by colourful crayons and paint pots.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Red, yellow, and blue are primary colours. You can mix them to make other colours!
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Đỏ, vàng và xanh dương là các màu cơ bản. Em có thể pha chúng để tạo ra các màu khác!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? A rainbow has seven colours: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet.
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Cầu vồng có bảy màu: đỏ, cam, vàng, xanh lá, xanh dương, chàm và tím.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Bees see colours differently than people. They can see ultraviolet light!
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Ong nhìn màu sắc khác với con người. Chúng có thể nhìn thấy tia cực tím!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Many leaves are green because of something called chlorophyll inside them.
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Nhiều chiếc lá có màu xanh vì một chất gọi là chất diệp lục bên trong chúng.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Honeycombs, where bees store honey, are made of many tiny hexagons (a shape with six sides)!
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Tổ ong, nơi ong cất mật, được tạo thành từ nhiều hình lục giác nhỏ (hình có sáu cạnh)!

project.title: MY COLOURFUL SHAPE COLLAGE
project.task: Create a collage using different colours and shapes. Cut out shapes from colourful paper and glue them onto a big paper to make a picture of your favourite animal or scene.
example: I see a red circle. It is an apple.
I see a blue square. It is a house.
I see a yellow sun. It is a circle.
project.present: Hello everyone! This is my colourful shape collage. I use red, blue, green, and yellow. I use circles, squares, and triangles. This is a red circle. It is a flower. This is a green triangle. It is a tree. I like my collage very much. Thank you!
project.image_prompt: A Vietnamese child happily presenting a vibrant and creative collage made from cut-out colourful paper shapes. The collage depicts a simple scene like a house, a tree, and a sun, all made from basic geometric shapes. The child is standing next to an easel with the collage, smiling brightly.

classroom_game.name: Colour and Shape Hunt
steps_en: The teacher calls out a colour and a shape, for example, 'red circle'.
Students, in pairs or groups, look for an object in the classroom that matches the colour and shape.
The first pair/group to point to a correct object and say 'I see a red circle!' gets a point.
The game continues with new colours and shapes.
The team with the most points at the end wins.
steps_vi: Giáo viên gọi tên một màu sắc và một hình dạng, ví dụ: 'red circle' (hình tròn màu đỏ).
Học sinh, theo cặp hoặc nhóm nhỏ, tìm một vật trong lớp học có màu sắc và hình dạng tương ứng.
Cặp/nhóm đầu tiên chỉ vào vật đúng và nói 'I see a red circle!' sẽ được một điểm.
Trò chơi tiếp tục với các màu sắc và hình dạng mới.
Đội có nhiều điểm nhất khi kết thúc sẽ thắng cuộc.

message_en: OUR WORLD IS FULL OF WONDERFUL COLOURS AND SHAPES!
message_vi: THẾ GIỚI CỦA CHÚNG TA ĐẦY RẪY NHỮNG MÀU SẮC VÀ HÌNH DẠNG TUYỆT VỜI!
message_body: Look around you, little learners! Every day, you can see amazing colours and shapes. They make our world beautiful and interesting. Keep exploring and finding new colours and shapes wherever you go!
value_line: Learn English – Learn to Love – Learn to Grow.
